conflicts.fact: Length of Mama Njeri's notebook dataset (days recorded)
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 and Lesson 9 use a 60-day sales record; Lesson 2 uses 90 days of data (27 good days out of 90). The phenomenon and Lesson 4 say three months.

conflicts.fact: Probability of a 'good day' / key Mama Njeri probabilities
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2: P(good day)=27/90=0.3. Lesson 8: P(good day)=0.6 (bad 0.4). Lesson 9: roughly 40% of days are good. Lesson 7 uses 3/5 from 'her notebook data from earlier lessons'. Lesson 4: sold-out 0.55 and half-unsold 0.30, which also conflicts with 0.3 for good days.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson contains the mutually exclusive addition rule
conflicts.versions: Lesson 6 says mutually exclusive events reduce to 'the rule from Lesson 5', but that rule was taught in Lesson 4; Lesson 5 covers independence.

conflicts.fact: Nakuru data counts and event definition (internal conflict affecting the sequence)
conflicts.versions: Predict phase uses 40/100 high sales and 35/100 heavy rain; Observe uses 8 H, 7 R, 3 both of 20 days giving 12 unique. Notes say n(H)+n(R)=15 and 'approximately 60%'. The model phase uses P(A)=0.40, P(B)=0.35, P(A∩B)=0.15, P(A∪B)=0.60 for good weather, not heavy rain, a changed event. Also the 40+35 prediction is stated as 'many predicted 75', which is consistent, but the 8/20 and 7/20 proportions do not match 0.40/0.35.

conflicts.fact: Number of coin tosses per group
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1: flip a coin 40 times (Overview/Observe). Lesson 5 overview says 20 trials of two coins, while the activity and Observed say 40 tosses.

conflicts.fact: Bottle-cap trials per student/group and the bottle-cap probability
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 says Lesson 1 individual data are ~30 flips each (e.g. 8 out of 30), pooled ~900, with bottle-cap near 0.3. Lesson 1 had groups doing 40 coin flips and says bottle-cap toss results without specifying 30. Lesson 2 'cap-up' ~0.3 also coincides with the good-day 0.3, suggesting confusion.

conflicts.fact: Name of the model/scale artefact created in Lesson 1
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 creates a number-line 'Probability Model' of the good-day probability; Lesson 2 says the Lesson 1 model explained why Mama Njeri cannot predict her sales, and refers to a 'Probability Scale strip' created in Lesson 1.
